cause: The old wait accepted any Retry button, including an intermediate/focus-preload error. It could lift the network block while the debounced typed lookup or rendering was still active.
fix: Require a non-canceled failed request for the exact endpoint and typed q, matching input, failed widget, loading=0 and visible Retry before restoring network.
assertions_preserved: Retry button selector and real click
Retry succeeds with options and loading=0
All authorization, HTTP, state, overflow and technical-label checks
